title: WPMS/371/2007 of RAKESH KUMAR Vs STATE AND ORS.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 371 of 2007 (M/S)

Rakesh Kumar S/O Sri Kukhveer Singh, R/O Village Paldi, District
Muzaffarnagar, U.P.
...... Petitioner
Versus
1. State of Uttaranchal through its Secretary Education,
Dehradun.
2. Director Vidyalayi Shiksha, Mayur Vihar, Dehradun.
3. Additional Director Education Garhwal Mandal, Pauri
Garhwal.
4. District Education Officer, Haridwar.
5. Sri Dr. Trilochan, Additional District Education Officer
(Basic) Haridwar.
6. Sri Anand Bhardwaj, Election Officer, Janta Inter College,
Majari Gummawala, Haridwar and presently posted at Khand
Siksha Adhikari, Narsan, Haridwar.
 .....Respondents
Sri Ajay Veer Pundir, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Sri Gopal Narain Srivastava, learned Brief Holder for the State-respondents 1-4.
Dated May 02, 2007.
Hon'ble B.S. Verma, J.
 By means of the present petition, the petitioner has
prayed for issue a writ, rule, order or directions in the nature of
certiorari quashing the order dated 3-10-2006 passed by the
respondent no.3 and order dated 24-4-2007 passed by respondent
no. 4 respectively. By the impugned order dated 3-10-2006 the
Additional Director Education has appointed Additional District
Education Officer (Basic) Haridwar as authorized controller for
conducting the elections of the institution and by the order dated
24-4-2007 approval was accorded conditionally to the newly
elected committee of management by the District Education
Officer.
 It is not disputed that the election of committee of
management was held on 17-4-2007. The grievance of the
petitioner is that the petitioner, who is life member of the

committee of management, was not informed by post before the
holding of election and his representation dated 19-4-2007 was not
considered by the respondent no.4 before granting the approval.
 The approval was granted by the District Education
Officer Haridwar on 24-4-2007 with the condition that if it is
detected in future that any fact appears to have been concealed or
any adverse fact comes to light regarding the validity of the
election, the approval shall stand cancelled automatically.
 I have heard the submissions made by the learned
counsel for the petitioner Sri Ajay Veer Pundir and perused the
averments made in the writ petition. In the writ petition disputed
questions of fact have been raised before this Court. The copy of
the representation dated 19-4-2007 is Annexure No.2 to the writ
petition. In this representation, the petitioner has nowhere
disclosed as to how and when he came to know regarding the
election. There is no positive averment that he had not at all
received any information through post. In exercise of writ
jurisdiction, disputed question of fact cannot be examined whether
the petitioner was served prior to the election or not.
 In the circumstances detailed above, the writ petition is
devoid of merit and is liable to be dismissed at admission stage.
 The writ petition is accordingly dismissed in limine.
However, the petitioner may approach to the appropriate Forum for
redressal of his grievance and he may avail appropriate remedy.
 All applications stand disposed of.
(B.S. Verma, J)
RCP
